Dr. Theodore Schwartz, MD

Neurosurgery | 30+ years of experience

30+ years of experience

Dr. Theodore Schwartz, MD is a neurosurgeon in New York, NY and has over 30 years of experience in the medical field. He graduated from Harvard in 1993. He is affiliated with Mount Sinai Hospital. He is accepting new patients and telehealth appointments.

Oct 14, 2024
×Post a ResponseAre you Dr. Schwartz?
I trusted him: biggest mistake I have made
I had high hopes when I chose Dr. Theodore Schwartz as my neurosurgeon, trusting his reputation and skill. When facing something as terrifying as a brain tumor, you hope for more than just technical expertise—you need kindness, compassion, and empathy. Unfortunately, my experience was deeply disappointing. I was scared and vulnerable, but instead of feeling supported, I felt disregarded. Dr. Schwartz seemed indifferent to me as a person, and that lack of compassion left a lasting impact. The nurse practitioners were often unkind, and the residents showed no empathy. I expected a medical team that would treat me with understanding, but that was far from my experience.I'm still dealing with several complications that stem directly from my surgery, but what’s been even more difficult is the way the entire team has shown such indifference to my struggles. Despite the ongoing issues I’m facing, it feels like no one truly cares or understands the lasting impact this has had on my life.

Kimberly – Oct 04, 2024
×Post a ResponseAre you Dr. Schwartz?
A Gifted Surgeon
On April 11,2024, my wife had a major brain surgery removing six meningiomas performed by Dr.Schwartz. It was a critical decision in choosing the right surgeon. We encountered many consultations with other neurosurgeons. We were impressed with the way Dr.Schwartz thoroughly arranged Mri's and images including the brain and spine. My wife and I are huge prayer warriors and live by our faith. We felt led by the Holy Spirit that Dr.Schwartz was the surgeon to perform the surgery. Immediately after the surgery was completed, Dr.Schwartz came out of the operating room and gave our son and I a complete summary of the successful surgery. He made the incision under the hairline doing a phenomenal job. You couldn't tell that my wife had surgery performed. She healed very well. We feel extremely blessed that God led us to the right surgeon with gifted hands to perform my wife's surgery. We write this review with heartfelt gratitude for a surgeon that gives his all to his patients.

Judith Mockler – Aug 19, 2024
×Post a ResponseAre you Dr. Schwartz?
Pituitary adenoma consultation and surgery
The purpose of my review is to let you know there is great help available. I was very concerned about having vision issues due to a brain tumor (pituitary adenoma) that was compressing my optic nerve. Brain surgery is a daunting prospect. We researched to find a neurosurgeon that we could trust for this most delicate surgery. So fortunately, we found Dr. Theodore Schwartz with NY Presbyterian Weill Cornell. He is an expert in this field of care. From the first consultation, I was relieved and confident that I found the right neurosurgeon. We learned he has done over 2,000 such surgeries. He completed a very successful surgery in 2024, and he and his team, incl. Dr. Tabee and Dr. Dobri, have managed my recovery wonderfully. Thankfully, we were able to consult with Dr. Schwartz within 10 days of diagnosis due to efforts of Rochelle, Christian and Elizabeth. You can't compare the amazing care of Dr. Schwartz & NY Presbyterian Weill Cornell team with others. Thank you for being the best!

A.B. – Mar 15, 2024
×Post a ResponseAre you Dr. Schwartz?
Greatest Neurosurgeon in the Country
I was recommended to Dr Theodore Schwartz when my ophthalmologist suspected a brain tumor was causing diminished vision in both eyes. I was afraid. I met with Dr Schwartz after an MRI. He diagnosed a very large pituitary adenoma. The tumor was putting pressure on my optic nerve and if it was not removed soon, I was going to completely lose my eyesight. Upon meeting Dr Schwartz I was immediately impressed with his calm demeanor, intelligence, confidence & compassion. I went into surgery with Dr. Schwartz in Dec. 2023, confident of a successful outcome. Dr Schwartz was able to remove the whole tumor, via the nose. It was a minimally invasive, 5 hour procedure, with a fairly quick recovery time. I did not experience any complications, other than after surgery discomfort. This man gave me my eyesight & my life back and I could never be more grateful to him. I highly respect & recommend Dr Schwartz to anyone in this or a similar situation. This man has hands of gold.
